exact_geometry.children: E_plus and E_minus are the order-505 Gaussian child translation groups used by the pinned runners
section_checks: projection is identity on all 101 parent sites
exact_geometry.fiber_offset: b_h(x) is the unique fiber residue satisfying s_CRT(x)=s_BFS(x)+b_h(x)*(10,1) in the child quotient
exact_geometry.residual_phase: u_h(x)=t_h(x)-b_h(x) mod5, using the runner's frozen rotation_gauges()

score.coordinates: fit in the original stored real/imaginary coordinates; never divide by A
score.blocks: radius4/radius5/radius6 covariance blocks are whitened exactly as P406, with relative eigenvalue cutoff 1e-10
score.channels: plus/minus hands and charges r1/r2 remain separate
score.primary: minimum block-whitened squared distance to mask-times-positive-Fourier cone
score.raw_comparator: recompute the P406 raw positive cone on the identical means/covariance and require exact numerical reproduction before comparison
score.increment: masked cone distance minus raw cone distance

bootstrap.method: same standard-normal draws in each resolved whitened channel, centered on that model's fitted vector and refitting its cone

identifiability_and_envelopes.linear: report masked design rank and nullity out of 101 spectral coordinates; do not call either a state count
identifiability_and_envelopes.spectral_mass: report 1%,50%,99% plug-in-bootstrap quantiles for total mass and per-frequency mass widths
identifiability_and_envelopes.prediction: report 1%-99% plug-in-bootstrap stored-coordinate prediction envelopes on all 101 parent residues
identifiability_and_envelopes.rejection_boundary: if the masked cone is rejected, label every spectral/prediction envelope model-conditional and state that there is no accepted CRT-degauged prediction envelope

controls: reproduce the published P406 raw distances and p values from the same archives
the exact residual-phase counts are (21,20,20,20,20) in both hands
no mask value vanishes; a zero would require equal phase counts, impossible because 5 does not divide 101
the pinned attenuation witnesses in Issue 418 must reproduce exactly
the mask Fourier spectrum is nonnegative up to floating roundoff
claim_boundary: This tests the section/gauge factorization and covariance contract before any physical interpretation.
A rejection does not identify a field count, a Jordan block, ordered memory or a continuum operator.
The four channel scores are correlated archive views and are not pooled as four independent votes.
No new random production, server use or rank-eight premise is introduced.
